members.name: Boss
does: Sets direction and makes the final picks
OKs anything sent to clients or posted publicly
Clears "Waiting on you" once a day (~10 min)

members.name: XX
does: Planning, task list, logs and HQ data
Reviews everything ZZ ships: code (375px, speed) and outreach/content for compliance (BNM/SC/FIMM ad rules, PDPA, AI labels)
Market research: who to target and why, competitors, pricing
Answers the boss's general questions first

members.name: ZZ
does: All sites and all design, incl. logos
Client pipeline: named lead lists, outreach drafts, posts, ad creatives, landing pages (drafts until the boss OKs)

rules: The boss never names us. Whoever it fits by role takes it: clients or how it looks → ZZ; running or knowing things → XX.
The owner posts "Taking: …" first. The other replies only if it's actually theirs or has something new.
Unclear whose? XX answers first and hands over or splits it in that same message.
Shared job? The owner posts the split, the other confirms, then both start.
Research first: XX's target brief before ZZ builds lead lists.
Nothing is sent, paid, deleted or posted without the boss's OK.
xx-v4, xx-v5 and xx-v6 are auto-push (XX reviews every push); other repos need the boss's OK.
